lifecycle.accessIntro: Suspending cuts access without removing the person: their tasks, place in the org chart and teams stay as they are.
lifecycle.stateActiveHint: The person sees and edits what their permissions allow.
lifecycle.stateSuspendedHint: No access to the organization until access is restored.
lifecycle.accessUntilHint: For a contractor or an intern: after this date, access ends on its own.
lifecycle.offboardIntro: Choose who takes over their work, then remove the person or simply suspend their access.
lifecycle.impactNone: Nothing to hand over: no open task, no direct report, no lead role, no key result.
lifecycle.leadsToHint: The chosen person is added to the team if they aren't in it yet.
lifecycle.modeRemoveHint: The person is notified and loses all access. They can come back with a new invitation.
lifecycle.modeSuspendHint: Access is cut, membership is kept: it can be restored.
lifecycle.transferIntro: Choose who takes over what. The person stays in the company; only the responsibilities change hands.
lifecycle.modeTransferHint: The person stays, with their access. A field left on “Leave unchanged” is not touched.

invites.emailIntro: Each address gets a personal link, valid for 7 days, that only its recipient can use.
invites.emailsPlaceholder: first.last@company.com, one per line or separated by commas
invites.placementHint: The person will arrive directly under this manager.
invites.mailUnavailable: The links were created, but sending emails isn't set up yet. Copy the links to share them yourself.
invites.statusCreatedMaybe: Link created, sending may have failed: resend it from Settings
invites.resendWait: At most one reminder per hour
invites.emailCardHint: One personal link per address, already placed in the org chart and teams. For a guest or contractor, set an access end date.

bulk.partial_one: {{count}} failed, {{done}} applied: the server refused the rest
bulk.partial_other: {{count}} failed, {{done}} applied: the server refused the rest

permissions.title: {{name}}'s permissions
permissions.intro: These settings override the rights inferred from the pyramid. A row left on “Default” follows the member's position in the company.
permissions.ceiling: You cannot grant a right you do not hold yourself.
permissions.assignNobody: Nobody — this member cannot assign any task.

task.createHint: Add a task to a team project.
task.editAnyHint: Edit a task they neither created nor were assigned. Their own tasks always stay editable.
task.deleteAnyHint: Delete a team task created by someone else.

project.deleteHint: Move a project out of the active view, or delete it permanently.
project.editHint: Rename, describe and schedule a project, change its team or owner.

okr.createHint: Create a team objective and its key results.
okr.deleteHint: Delete a team objective or one of its key results.

category.manageHint: Create, rename and delete project and OKR categories.

team.createHint: Create a cross-functional team and set its members.

member.inviteHint: Generate an invite link to a seat in the pyramid.

target.selfHint: They can assign a task to themselves.
target.peersHint: Members who report to the same direct manager.
target.managerHint: The person right above them in the pyramid.
target.subordinatesHint: Everyone placed below them, at any depth.
target.everyoneHint: Any member of the company. Makes the other boxes irrelevant.

permissions.presetGuestHint: Creates, deletes and invites nothing; can only assign to themselves. Set the duration in “Access and suspension”.

myRights.title: My rights
myRights.hint: What you can do in this company, and why. A right “set for you” overrides the one from your position.
myRights.adminHint: Administrator: every right, no exception. No override applies to an admin.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership of {{org}}
transfer.body: The chosen member becomes owner and administrator. You remain an administrator, but only the new owner will be able to transfer again or delete the company.
transfer.billingSubscription: The company subscription continues without interruption: the new owner will manage it (plan, cancellation, refund).
transfer.billingNoSubscription: No paid subscription is running; if one is taken out, the new owner will manage it.
transfer.billingInvoices: Past and future invoices will be available to the new owner, from the Billing tab.
transfer.billingCard: The saved payment method stays the current one until the new owner changes it: remember to tell them.
transfer.billingYou: You will lose access to billing as soon as you confirm.

leaveDialog.body: You'll immediately lose access to the team's projects, tasks and OKRs. Your personal data (tasks, habits, calendar) is not affected. You can come back with a new invitation code.
leaveDialog.title: Leave {{org}}?
leaveDialog.impactTasks_one: {{count}} open task assigned to you will be unassigned
leaveDialog.impactTasks_other: {{count}} open tasks assigned to you will be unassigned
leaveDialog.impactReports_one: {{count}} direct report will move up under your manager
leaveDialog.impactReports_other: {{count}} direct reports will move up under your manager
leaveDialog.impactProjects_one: {{count}} project you own will have no owner
leaveDialog.impactProjects_other: {{count}} projects you own will have no owner

deleteOrg.projectsDeleted: All projects, team tasks and OKRs are permanently deleted.
deleteOrg.teamsErased: Teams, invitations and the pyramid are erased.
deleteOrg.subscriptionFirst: An ongoing subscription must be cancelled FIRST: deletion is refused while it is active.
deleteOrg.evidenceKept: Renewal notices and withdrawal waivers are kept: they are legal records, not company data.
deleteOrg.personalSafe: Members' personal data is not affected.

projectTeams.title: Teams of “{{name}}”
projectTeams.description: The main team stays the project's. An associated team can also read the project and its tasks; removing it takes that view away.
projectTeams.none: No associated team: only the main team (and its managers) see this project.
projectTeams.confirmBody: Every member of {{team}}, and their managers, will see “{{project}}” and its tasks.

projectPurge.title: Permanently delete “{{name}}”?
projectPurge.impactTasks_one: {{count}} task, with its comments and subtasks, will be deleted
projectPurge.impactTasks_other: {{count}} tasks, with their comments and subtasks, will be deleted
projectPurge.impactMilestones: Its milestones, dependencies and links to key results go with it.
projectPurge.impactIrreversible: None of this goes to the trash: it is permanent.

teamLeave.title: Remove {{member}} from {{team}}?
teamLeave.body_one: {{member}} will no longer see {{count}} project, open only to this team. Their tasks in it will leave their lists.
teamLeave.body_other: {{member}} will no longer see {{count}} projects, open only to this team. Their tasks in them will leave their lists.

teamBulk.title: Add to {{team}}
teamBulk.description: Tick the people to add: they will see the team's projects straight away.

okrDelete.title: Delete the objective “{{title}}”?
okrDelete.impactKrs_one: {{count}} key result and its check-ins will be deleted
okrDelete.impactKrs_other: {{count}} key results and their check-ins will be deleted
okrDelete.impactProjects_one: {{count}} project will lose its link to this objective
okrDelete.impactProjects_other: {{count}} projects will lose their link to this objective
okrDelete.impactChildren_one: {{count}} contributing objective will lose its parent
okrDelete.impactChildren_other: {{count}} contributing objectives will lose their parent
okrDelete.impactIrreversible: A deleted objective cannot be restored.

pyramid.undoConfirm_one: Undo the reorganisation? The move you made will be reverted.
pyramid.undoConfirm_other: Undo the reorganisation? The {{count}} moves you made will be reverted.
pyramid.dragBanner: Drag **{{name}}** onto their new manager, or tap a highlighted card.
pyramid.unplacedHintAdmin: These members don't report to anyone. Place them in the pyramid.
pyramid.unplacedHintMember: These members don't report to anyone. An administrator needs to place them.
pyramid.intro: The pyramid shows who works with whom: each member reports to a direct manager. Invite your colleagues to build it.
pyramid.reorgBanner: Reorganisation mode: drag any card onto its new manager.
pyramid.noMemberInTeam: No member placed in this team
pyramid.addMembersHint: Add members to the team from the Members tab.
pyramid.toPlaceAria: Members to place in the pyramid
pyramid.searchAria: Search a member in the pyramid
pyramid.dragEachHint: Drag each person onto their manager in the pyramid.
pyramid.overlayHint: Colors cards by estimated time left
pyramid.positionBody: This move changes who manages whom. The people involved will be notified.
pyramid.positionLoses: {{name}} will no longer manage anyone: their team's Org chart and Statistics will be closed to them.
pyramid.positionGains: {{name}} will become a manager: Org chart and Statistics will open to them.

weeklyReview.title: Weekly review
weeklyReview.subtitle: Four questions to prepare your Monday.
weeklyReview.slippedEmpty: No deadline pushed back over the last two weeks.
weeklyReview.tensionEmpty: Nobody above the team's median workload.
weeklyReview.arbitrageEmpty: No overdue task, nothing to decide.
weeklyReview.arbitrageHint: Open each task to reschedule, reassign or drop it.
weeklyReview.scopeSubtree: My team (my branch of the org chart)
weeklyReview.notePlaceholder: What was decided, who owns it…
weeklyReview.historyEmpty: No saved review for this scope.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Deleted tasks stay here for {{days}} days, with their comments, subtasks and history. Restored, they come back exactly as they were.
